case_id_definition: Concatenation of BELNR + BUKRS + GJAHR where BSEG.KOART = 'K'

activity_definitions.name: Create Invoice
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: BKPF.BUDAT (First posting of document with BLART = invoice type)

activity_definitions.name: Set Payment Block
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: CDHDR.UDATE where CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' and VALUE_NEW is not empty

kpis.name: Cycle Time: Invoice to Payment
kpis.description: Average time from invoice creation to payment issuance

kpis.name: Payment Block Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of invoices that have a payment block set
kpis.calculation_idea: COUNT(CASE WHEN Set Payment Block IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE_ID)

acceptance_rules: Case key must be unique per Accounting Document Header
Only include documents where account type is Vendor
Ensure clearing date is only captured when AUGBL is present
